findings.title: Container exceeded its ephemeral storage limit
findings.cause: the pod was evicted for writing more to its local disk than its ephemeral-storage limit (10Mi); Deployment web has 1 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: pod status is Failed, reason Evicted
evidence.detail: Pod ephemeral local storage usage exceeds the total limit of containers 10Mi.
evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-84cfc45967-29qwv -n kd-ephemeral-storage-limit -o jsonpath='{.status.message}'

findings.fix: Raise the container's ephemeral-storage limit, or move what it writes (logs, caches, scratch files) to a volume.
